The answer is B, about $3k. My recollection is that Maddison-based estimates put US GDP per capita in 1850 at roughly $1,800 in 1990 international dollars, or about $3,500–4,500 in 2011 prices. Of the options, $3k is the closest. That is a recalled figure, not one I looked up.

CONFIDENCE: 80
